about: One draft and its source, read by both the Python checks and the page (web/tests/posts.evidence.test.ts), so the two always find the same numbers and quotations under the same keys. Invented text.
sentences: The valley council said on Monday that 1,240 homes added solar panels last year.
That is 38% more than the year before.
"We have never seen demand like this," said the council's energy officer.
Installers report waiting lists of up to 14 weeks.
body: Solar roofs: 1,240 homes added panels, 38% more than before. “We have never seen demand like this,” said the energy officer. Waits reach 14 weeks, and 2.5 million panels are on order. A neighbour told us "it was worth every penny".
